parameters.query:
SELECT json_build_object(
  'generated_at', now(),
  'users', json_build_object(
    'total',            (SELECT count(*) FROM users),
    'new_7d',           (SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days'),
    'new_30d',          (SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days'),
    'sc_verified',      (SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE sc_verified),
    'inactive',         (SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE NOT coalesce(is_active, true)),
    'banned',           (SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE banned_at IS NOT NULL),
    'by_role',          (SELECT json_object_agg(r, n) FROM (SELECT coalesce(role, 'none') r, count(*) n FROM users GROUP BY 1) x),
    'active_login_1d',  (SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FROM auth_providers WHERE last_login_at > now() - interval '1 day'),
    'active_login_7d',  (SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FROM auth_providers WHERE last_login_at > now() - interval '7 days'),
    'active_login_30d', (SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FROM auth_providers WHERE last_login_at > now() - interval '30 days'),
    'active_login_7d_by_provider', (SELECT json_object_agg(p, n) FROM (SELECT provider p, count(DISTINCT user_id) n FROM auth_providers WHERE last_login_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1) x),
    'signups_per_day_30d', (SELECT json_agg(x ORDER BY x.day) FROM (SELECT created_at::date AS day, count(*) AS n FROM users WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1) x),
    'with_org',         (SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FROM user_orgs),
    'orgs_total',       (SELECT count(*) FROM sc_orgs),
    'top_orgs',         (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT o.name, o.slug, count(DISTINCT uo.user_id) AS site_members, o.member_count
                           FROM sc_orgs o JOIN user_orgs uo ON uo.org_id = o.org_id
                           GROUP BY o.org_id, o.name, o.slug, o.member_count ORDER BY 3 DESC, 1 LIMIT 10) x)
  ),
  'usage', json_build_object(
    'total_rows',     (SELECT count(*) FROM site_request_log),
    'first_logged',   (SELECT min(logged_at) FROM site_request_log),
    'last_logged',    (SELECT max(logged_at) FROM site_request_log),
    'requests_1d',    (SELECT count(*) FROM site_request_log WHERE logged_at > now() - interval '1 day'),
    'requests_7d',    (SELECT count(*) FROM site_request_log WHERE logged_at > now() - interval '7 days'),
    'requests_30d',   (SELECT count(*) FROM site_request_log WHERE logged_at > now() - interval '30 days'),
    'users_used_1d',  (SELECT count(DISTINCT user_name) FROM site_request_log WHERE logged_at > now() - interval '1 day'  AND coalesce(auth, '') NOT IN ('not-logged-in', 'shared', 'bot', '') AND coalesce(user_name, '') NOT IN ('not-logged-in', 'shared', '')),
    'users_used_7d',  (SELECT count(DISTINCT user_name) FROM site_request_log WHERE logged_at > now() - interval '7 days' AND coalesce(auth, '') NOT IN ('not-logged-in', 'shared', 'bot', '') AND coalesce(user_name, '') NOT IN ('not-logged-in', 'shared', '')),
    'users_used_30d', (SELECT count(DISTINCT user_name) FROM site_request_log WHERE logged_at > now() - interval '30 days' AND coalesce(auth, '') NOT IN ('not-logged-in', 'shared', 'bot', '') AND coalesce(user_name, '') NOT IN ('not-logged-in', 'shared', '')),
    'per_day_14d',    (SELECT json_agg(x ORDER BY x.day, x.endpoint) FROM (SELECT logged_at::date AS day, endpoint, count(*) AS n FROM site_request_log WHERE logged_at > now() - interval '14 days' GROUP BY 1, 2) x),
    'by_endpoint_7d', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT endpoint, count(*) AS n FROM site_request_log WHERE logged_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC) x),
    'by_auth_7d',     (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT coalesce(auth, '(none)') AS auth, count(*) AS n FROM site_request_log WHERE logged_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC) x),
    'by_user_7d',     (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT coalesce(user_name, '(none)') AS user_name, coalesce(auth, '(none)') AS auth, count(*) AS n FROM site_request_log WHERE logged_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 25) x),
    'by_bot_7d',      (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT coalesce(bot, '(none)') AS bot, count(*) AS n FROM site_request_log WHERE logged_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15) x),
    'by_reason_7d',   (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT coalesce(reason, '(none)') AS reason, count(*) AS n FROM site_request_log WHERE logged_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15) x),
    'by_source_7d',   (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT coalesce(source, '(none)') AS source, count(*) AS n FROM site_request_log WHERE logged_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15) x),
    'by_status_7d',   (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT coalesce(status, '(none)') AS status, count(*) AS n FROM site_request_log WHERE logged_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC) x),
    'top_lookups_7d', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT l.slug, (SELECT max(e.name) FROM entity_display e WHERE e.slug = l.slug) AS name, count(*) AS n
                         FROM site_request_log l WHERE l.logged_at > now() - interval '7 days' AND l.slug IS NOT NULL AND l.endpoint ILIKE '%lookup%'
                         GROUP BY l.slug ORDER BY 3 DESC, 1 LIMIT 15) x),
    'top_searches_7d', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT lower(q) AS q, count(*) AS n, max(result_count) AS max_results FROM site_request_log
                         WHERE logged_at > now() - interval '7 days' AND coalesce(q, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 15) x),
    'zero_result_searches_7d', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT lower(q) AS q, count(*) AS n FROM site_request_log
                         WHERE logged_at > now() - interval '7 days' AND coalesce(q, '') <> '' AND (status = 'empty' OR result_count = 0) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 15) x),
    'not_found_7d',   (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT slug, count(*) AS n FROM site_request_log
                         WHERE logged_at > now() - interval '7 days' AND slug IS NOT NULL AND (status = 'not-found' OR found IS FALSE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 15) x),
    'perf_7d',        (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT endpoint, count(duration_ms) AS timed,
                         round(percentile_cont(0.5)  WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms)::numeric) AS p50_ms,
                         round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms)::numeric) AS p95_ms
                         FROM site_request_log WHERE logged_at > now() - interval '7 days' AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1) x),
    'failures_per_day_14d', (SELECT json_agg(x ORDER BY x.day) FROM (SELECT logged_at::date AS day, count(*) AS n FROM site_request_log
                         WHERE logged_at > now() - interval '14 days' AND coalesce(error, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1) x),
    'top_failures_7d', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT endpoint, error, count(*) AS n FROM site_request_log
                         WHERE logged_at > now() - interval '7 days' AND coalesce(error, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 15) x)
  ),
  'raw', json_build_object(
    'users', json_build_object('count', (SELECT count(*) FROM users), 'rows', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
        SELECT user_id, display_name, avatar_url, role, sc_handle, sc_verified, sc_verified_at, is_active, banned_at, ban_reason, created_at, updated_at, managed_org_id
        FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50) x)),
    'auth_providers', json_build_object('count', (SELECT count(*) FROM auth_providers), 'rows', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
        SELECT id, user_id, provider, provider_id, username, avatar_url, token_expires_at, connected_at, last_login_at
        FROM auth_providers ORDER BY last_login_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50) x)),
    'user_orgs', json_build_object('count', (SELECT count(*) FROM user_orgs), 'rows', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
        SELECT user_id, org_id, is_main_org, org_role, synced_at FROM user_orgs ORDER BY synced_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50) x)),
    'sc_orgs', json_build_object('count', (SELECT count(*) FROM sc_orgs), 'rows', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
        SELECT org_id, slug, name, description, logo_url, rsi_url, site_url, discord_invite, is_visible, is_recruiting, source, member_count,
               created_at, updated_at, verified_at, verified_by, pending_verify_expires_at, manager_description
        FROM sc_orgs ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50) x)),
    'user_preferences', json_build_object('count', (SELECT count(*) FROM user_preferences), 'rows', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
        SELECT user_id, color_theme, sidebar_state, ui_density, updated_at FROM user_preferences ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50) x)),
    'site_request_log', json_build_object('count', (SELECT count(*) FROM site_request_log), 'rows', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
        SELECT id, logged_at, endpoint, method, q, slug, filters, status, error, found, result_count, top_results, matched_by, duration_ms,
               reason, source, auth, user_name, view_id, prefetch, bot
        FROM site_request_log ORDER BY logged_at DESC LIMIT 50) x)),
    'site_request_monthly', json_build_object('count', (SELECT count(*) FROM site_request_monthly), 'rows', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
        SELECT month, metric, endpoint, key, count, p50_ms, p95_ms, raw_row_count, raw_table_bytes, new_rows, computed_at
        FROM site_request_monthly ORDER BY month DESC, metric, count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50) x)),
    'notices', json_build_object('count', (SELECT count(*) FROM notices), 'rows', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
        SELECT id, message, type, active, priority, target_pages, expires_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM notices ORDER BY created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50) x)),
    'changelog', json_build_object('count', (SELECT count(*) FROM changelog), 'rows', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (
        SELECT id, version, release_date, label, title, published, created_at FROM changelog ORDER BY created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50) x))
  )
) AS data
